description: Use when the user asks for the assay geochemistry (sample concentrations) around a point. Returns, per sample type (STREA stream sediment, ROCKC rock chip, DRILL, SHALL, SOIL) and per element, concentration statistics in ppm (n, min, p50, p90, max, mean), and the highest-value samples, with coordinates, for the first element in `elements`. Pass raw=true for the per-sample arrays when there are 500 samples or fewer.

elements.description: Subset of Cu, Au, Mo, Ag, Pb, Zn, Co, Bi, Ni, W, As, Sn, Cr, Sb (default Au, Cu, As). The highest-value samples are ranked by the first.

raw.description: Return the per-sample arrays if n <= 500.

sample_types.description: Subset of STREA, ROCKC, DRILL, SHALL, SOIL (default all).

name: get_geochem
title: Get geochemistry near a point
